🖥️ OVERVIEW LAYOUT
• The bot cards were crammed against the left because the grid reserved a phantom 3rd column that ate a third of the width. Removed it — cards now spread evenly across the full window, and a lone last card spans the full width.

📊 TOOLS → IBKR LIVE ALLOCATION
